model.gate: Bind one proposal, caller evidence envelope, live exact-six-file observation, and live toolchain observation to a fixed replay-isolation policy receipt.
model.certification: When Bubblewrap, prlimit, and Node are usable, run only a trusted fixed probe inside an empty-root sandbox with user, PID, IPC, UTS, network, and cgroup namespaces, all capabilities dropped, a read-only /usr, an exact read-only Node executable, ephemeral /tmp, and hard resource limits.
model.unavailableHost: When the current host cannot create the required namespace, emit a digest-bound qualified hold and spawn no replay-policy process.
model.futureReplay: Certification is a prerequisite for a separately authorized future caller-test replay Hand. This Hand never mounts, imports, or executes proposal bytes or caller tests.
